name: Dusky Crab Cakes
summary: Dusky Crab Cakes are a savory dish prepared by Chef Grual in Darkshire to satisfy the desperate hunger of Jitters. The local delicacy has a tangy flavor, and a famished Jitters considers it an exquisite meal.

sections.title: A Questionable Delicacy
sections.body: In the gloom of Duskwood, fresh provisions are scarce and cooks must make do with whatever meat the darkened forest yields. When the terrified vagrant Jitters finds himself racked with hunger pains, Chef Grual whips up a batch of his signature 'crab' cakes. To any outsider, the dish appears to be an innocent seafood patty, but Grual's secret ingredient is far less appetizing: the sinewy, gooey legs of Duskwood's monstrous arachnids. The cakes are quickly devoured by the ravenous Jitters, completely oblivious to what he is actually eating.

faq.q: What are Dusky Crab Cakes actually made of?
aliases: what is in dusky crab cakes
faq.answer: Chef Grual keeps the recipe for his specialty to himself. Its secret ingredient is revealed while gathering supplies for him in Duskwood.

faq.q: Who eats the Dusky Crab Cakes?
faq.answer: The cakes are prepared for Jitters, an anxious man sheltering at Raven Hill who is complaining of an intensely rumbling stomach.

faq.q: Does Jitters know the cakes are made of spider legs?
faq.answer: Jitters is starving and happily devours the cakes without questioning the recipe, grateful only that they hit the spot.

faq.q: Who cooks the Dusky Crab Cakes?
faq.answer: Chef Grual, the resident cook at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, prepares the dish using the spider legs brought to him.

angles.text: Grual's cakes show how a creative cook can make a tangy local specialty from the ingredients available in Duskwood.
